content.short: SolanaFM provides a blockchain explorer, API, and analytics platform with indexing solutions for Solana.
content.description: SolanaFM is a user-friendly blockchain explorer, API, and analytics platform focused on Solana. It provides indexing solutions to access Solana's full historical data through efficient, dynamic APIs and presents on-chain data and analysis in a clear, navigable way. A large portion of SolanaFM's functionality is built using GraphQL, empowering developers to explore, assemble, and manipulate data as needed for building and testing applications.
